terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.s1Body: These terms apply to the use of the solen.ch platform. By registering, you accept these terms.
terms.s2Body: Solen.ch facilitates bookings between customers and salons in the Basel area. The platform provides the technical infrastructure.
terms.s3Body: Registration is required to use the platform as a salon owner. Information must be truthful and complete.
terms.s4Body: Payments are processed through Stripe. Solen.ch charges a platform fee according to the current pricing plan.
terms.s5Body: Solen.ch is not liable for the quality of services provided by salons. Liability is limited to the amount of the platform fee.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.s1Body: The data controller is solen.ch, Basel, Switzerland.
privacy.s2Body: We collect name, email address, phone number, and booking data. For salons, we additionally collect business address and payment information.
privacy.s3Body: Your data is used exclusively to provide our services. We do not share data with third parties, except for payment processing (Stripe).
privacy.s4Body: We use technically necessary cookies and analytics cookies (PostHog). You can disable cookies in your browser settings.
privacy.s5Body: You have the right to access, rectify, and delete your data. Contact us at datenschutz@solen.ch.

partner.compare_savings_text: With CHF 1,000 monthly revenue via Solen, you save CHF 290/month compared to Treatwell.
partner.faq_subtitle: Everything salon owners want to know
partner.faq_cost_a: Solen charges only 1% commission per successful booking. No monthly fees, no setup costs, no hidden charges. You only pay when you actually gain clients.
partner.faq_contract_a: No. You can use Solen anytime without a contract and pause or deactivate your profile whenever you want — no notice period required.
partner.faq_payments_a: Payments run through Stripe Connect. Clients pay online and you receive the amount directly to your bank account. You can also offer in-salon payment or deposits.
partner.faq_edit_profile_q: Can I edit my profile anytime?
partner.faq_edit_profile_a: Yes, absolutely. You can update your profile, services, prices, opening hours and team anytime from your dashboard — changes go live instantly.
partner.faq_more_clients_q: How do I get more clients?
partner.faq_more_clients_a: Your salon appears on solen.ch and is visible to thousands of users in Basel. You can also publish last-minute deals and collect reviews to boost your visibility.
partner.faq_no_show_a: You can set cancellation policies — e.g. fees for late cancellations. Automatic SMS reminders 24h and 1h before the appointment drastically reduce no-shows.
partner.faq_existing_system_q: Can I keep my existing system?
partner.faq_existing_system_a: Yes. Solen can run alongside your existing system. It doesn't replace your current software — it brings you additional clients through our platform.
partner.faq_how_fast_q: How fast can I go live?
partner.faq_how_fast_a: In less than 5 minutes. Sign up, add your services, and your salon is instantly visible on solen.ch. Our setup wizard guides you through every step.
partner.faq_categories_a: Hair salons, barbershops, nail studios, spa & wellness, makeup and waxing. Each category has specialized features — from nail portfolios to barber queues.
